headline: Jeffrey’s trapped in a whale! Well, not really, but we simulated what that would feel like
body: Jeffrey’s trapped in a whale! Well, not really, but we simulated what that would feel like. It’s inspired by Whalefall, the claustrophobic thriller where a diver gets swallowed by a whale. Experience Whalefall, now playing only in theaters. Presented by.
